# scripts/Deploy-LiquidwareTier.ps1

<!-- Generated by scripts/Update-BrainDocs.ps1 from the code. Do not edit; edit the code and regenerate. -->

Deploys ProfileUnity, FlexApp, Stratusphere and CommandCTRL against an existing avd-landing-zone landing zone.
